# Dentistry for Children & Adolescents

> Pediatric dental practice with multiple Minnesota locations providing specialized care for children and teens using advanced techniques like laser dentistry and behavior management.

Dentistry for Children & Adolescents operates three clinic locations in the Minneapolis-St. Paul area (Edina, Burnsville, and Eden Prairie) and specializes in pediatric dental care, special needs dentistry, and adolescent oral health. The practice is led by Dr. Gayathri Sambasivan and team members with credentials from University of Minnesota and Children's Hospitals & Clinics.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Children's Dental Care
- Adolescent Oral Health
- Special Needs Dentistry
- Laser Dentistry
- Silver Diamine Fluoride Treatment
- Intraosseous Anesthesia
- Behavior Management
- Edina, Minnesota
- Burnsville Office
- Eden Prairie Office
- Doctor Referrals
- Appointment Scheduling
- Patient Intake
- Office Policies
